name: heditor
description: HEditor —— 文档引擎（wasm）与外部 API 层

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:types && npm run build:worker
scripts.build:app: npm run build:lib && npm run build:worker && vite build
scripts.check: npm run build:types && python ../scripts/gen_payloads.py --check && python ../scripts/gen_public_members.py --check && python ../scripts/lint_comments.py && python ../scripts/check_docs_cpp.py && node ../scripts/idl_check.mjs && node ../scripts/api_check.mjs && node ../scripts/check_docs.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests
